source_book: Sri Chaitanya — IPE STUDY MATERIAL for Jr. Students, Chemistry (2026-27 edition)
note: Question index for diffing and authoring; stems restated in our own wording, chemistry exact, no solution content by policy. Printed numbers 1-40 run continuously: VSAQ 1-15 (16 questions, Q5 has two parts), SAQ 16-33 (21 questions, Q30 has four parts), LAQ 34-40 (11 questions, Q36 four parts, Q40 two parts), INTEXT SOLVED PROBLEMS 3.1-3.4 (4). Scan page 26 (printed 28) is an ordinary text page, not blank; the footer page number on scan page 32 is cropped off (printed 34 by sequence) and the '40' on scan page 38 is half cropped. Several questions repeat inside the chapter (Q9=Q19, Q10=Q25, Q6=3.1, Q7/Q8 = parts of Q36, Q32/Q33 = parts of Q40).
